reviews.title: SOOO MUCH FUN.. Perf. for work desk- *Can gift assembled in vase.. SO CLEVER!!!
reviews.body: Iconic! Legos are universally loved by male/females alike.. THEY'RE JUST SO FUN!! This set is for ages 8/10yr. to adult (any who can identify pieces, follow visual instruct. and have dexterity to clip into place.) Legos fuel imagination, aid cognitive skills + dexterity, provide a fab. stress reliever.. Easy to wipe clean or soapy water wash.Set itself had all pieces that came clearly marked in smaller bags.. (even had a few extra parts!) This design is particularly fun to gift already built and in a vase.. or, leave in box- you got options. Mine assembled into small vase and gifted to his sisters work desk.. it was perfect idea! Made with a fun, unique look that brightens any "flower space" and looks the part.. Ha! X2 buds allow adjusting to open flower petals into full bloom or close.. All x3 flowers have their own feature in this set, including x1 sweet bud! Adjustable height option by removing a blocks from the stem.. PERFECT FINAL PRODUCT!! Could be SO CLEVER for a party, Anniversary, engagement wedding, etc.. they'd be a total hit!So much value for purchase especially for Lego brand! The fact set can be built over/over, join larger collection and pass on through a families entire child rearing phase. Easily stored for next generation of grandkids!! My advice: save booklets together in binder to always have when needed! Hoping info can help others- stay safe everyone.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 9, 2025

reviews.title: Adorable and Thoughtful Gift Idea
reviews.body: These LEGO lotus flowers are absolutely adorable! We built them as part of a thank-you gift for my son’s kindergarten teacher, and they turned out so cute. The set is easy to assemble, even for younger builders with a little help, and the end result looks surprisingly elegant for being made of bricks.It’s a creative and unique alternative to real flowers—plus, no wilting! Perfect for teacher gifts, small decorations, or just a fun little build to brighten someone’s day.
